sources: Sakura Sakura — Japanese traditional melody (Edo period); public domain
notes: D minor (D E F A B-flat), E4-F5, ends on A (the fifth) as the tune does. Written a fourth above the usual A minor so no note falls below middle C, which the score writer would put on the bass staff. Written out from memory in the simplest form; no network in the build environment, so not compared against an online score. Needs a listen by a person.
